Welcome to Goldphoenix

Education that shapes more than a report card.

At Goldphoenix Christian College, education is a journey of discovery and growth. Our school brings together a primary and secondary pathway, with day and boarding options for families seeking a supportive place for their children to learn.

We want every learner to develop strong foundations, ask thoughtful questions, build positive relationships and prepare confidently for the opportunities ahead.

✓ Purposeful learning
✓ Character and integrity
✓ A Christian ethos
✓ Growth and confidence

Life at Goldphoenix

A place to learn, connect and belong.

Every learner's school experience is different. Choose the day or boarding option that works for your family, then speak with our admissions team about the details.

For day learners
☀

Learning alongside family life.

Day learners attend school and return home after the school day. Families can contact the school for the daily timetable, transport information and current arrangements.

For boarding learners
⌂

A residential school experience.

Boarding offers families a residential pathway. Speak with the college about accommodation, supervision, meals, weekend routines and what learners should bring.
